configuration_adaptation.gate: candidate-only full-role snapshot fence while HTTPS JWKS response is held
configuration_adaptation.partial: role_type=jwt explicit in partial writes to avoid official default OIDC role behavior
configuration_adaptation.remote: same JWKS URL and API jwks_ca_pem; candidate startup endpoints empty
configuration_adaptation.scope: signed JWT login only; not OIDC code/UserInfo, proof API, out-of-i64 claims or arrays of composite values
configuration_adaptation.static_oracle: bound_issuer and PEM jwt_validation_pubkeys with ES256
